title: NextSlide joins OpenAI to bring presentation-making ideas into ChatGPT
friendlyTitle: The NextSlide team is now working on ChatGPT
summary: NextSlide says its team has joined OpenAI and is now working on ChatGPT. The startup built software that turned prompts, notes, documents and research into polished, editable presentations; no product timeline or deal terms were announced.
friendlySummary: NextSlide made a tool that turned notes and research into editable presentations. Its team has joined OpenAI and is now helping to build ChatGPT.
whyItMatters: Presentation creation is a common knowledge-work bottleneck. The move signals that editable visual communication may become a deeper part of ChatGPT, but users should treat that as direction rather than a promised feature until OpenAI provides details.
friendlyWhyItMatters: ChatGPT may become more helpful for making clear presentations. There is no date yet, so this is a sign of what may come next, not a finished feature.
